NIA chargesheets nine in online radicalisation case linked to ISIS

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has filed a chargesheet against nine individuals in connection with an online radicalisation case linked to the Islamic State (ISIS). The accused allegedly aimed to recruit youth for terrorist activities. The chargesheet was filed in a special NIA court. The agency also stated that the accused had developed an application for secret communication.
